data.narrative:
Reflection AI is a Series A artificial intelligence and software company founded by Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou, having raised $2.0B to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparator (Palantir, ticker PLTR) in the AI & Software sector at Series B and adjacent stages.

Only one valuation method proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis was excluded because the reported post-money valuation of $25.0B exceeds 20x total capital raised, indicating a data integrity issue. The peer-median approach anchors the analysis on four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Scale AI ($29.0B, Series B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B, Series B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B, Series B), and Field AI ($2.0B, Series B). The median valuation across this set is $4.4B, with a range of $2.0B to $29.0B.

This analysis supports a valuation range of $3.8B to $5.1B, centered on $4.4B. The wide dispersion in peer valuations—driven largely by Scale AI's outlier positioning—introduces material uncertainty. The absence of multiple triangulation methods limits confidence; reliance on peer multiples alone is sensitive to comparability judgments within the Series B cohort and stage-progression dynamics from Series A to B. Confidence in the $4.4B median is moderate pending additional method validation or clarification of the reported $25.0B figure.
